title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode8 The Promise I Made

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line: Yeah! She stands head and shoulders above everyone else her age.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel like she's sort of lost her step.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It still felt like I couldn't sing with everything I had.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(This has been happening a lot recently.
I keep singing and singing, but feel like I'm missing something.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's okay, Kohane.
You don't need to apologize...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I should've done more to protect you back there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But...!
I promise to look after you from now on!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll make sure you can have the confidence to sing without any fear!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kohane... Let's keep singing together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really, really appreciate everything you just said.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I do really want to keep singing with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to keep on chasing after that dream with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so...scared of performing on stage again...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then there's no way I can keep singing with you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which means I can't surpass that legendary event with you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's too afraid to sing right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Even if I tell her that everything's gonna be okay and force her back on stage...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She'll just end up suffering even more.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want you to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because I really love the way you sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I genuinely believe that you have what it takes to surpass that legendary event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll make it happen, for sure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's too selfish of me to keep hoping that she'll come back around.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's my fault for dragging her into this mess. She wouldn't have gotten hurt if I hadn't asked her to sing with me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What am I doing?
I shouldn't be acting all mopey after a show.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I already apologized to her about making her perform on stage like that, so there's nothing more I can do to change things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I made a promise to Kohane.
I said that I'm gonna make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to keep moving forward.
